title: Online Reputation Management: Estimating the Impact of Management Responses on Consumer Reviews
near_miss_reason: Within-hotel cross-platform DDD. Every reported column regresses review stars on `after` (TripAdvisor review x post-first-response, the treatment) together with `first_response` (hotel-level post-first-response indicator, an additional staggered regressor that is also on for Expedia reviews), ta_dummy, a TripAdvisor-specific linear trend (c.ta_dummy#c.t) and month FE, with hotel (not hotel-platform) FE. This is the 'triple difference with an additional staggered regressor' case in PROTOCOL 5b (same structure as near-miss mnsc.2023.01006), plus an assignment-group-specific linear trend. The within-TripAdvisor month-stayed DD adds time-since-stay polynomials and a treated-group linear trend.
eligible_reason: Binary absorbing treatment (hotel starts responding to TripAdvisor reviews) switches on at hotel-specific months: in the shipped data 2,525 of 4,604 hotels have a response onset, spread over 102 distinct onset months (t), and the rest never respond. No reported column is a plain TWFE in the treatment: all cross-platform columns include the hotel-level first_response term and the TA-specific trend; column 3 of the main table adds lagged cumulative rating and lagged review count; the DDD table adds treated x month and TA x month FE plus treated and TA main effects; heterogeneity tables add after x responses_posted interactions (continuous). Not eligible under PROTOCOL Section 2 and 5b; recorded as near-miss.
design_notes: Stata. replication/mktsci-code.do on data/responses.dta (830,003 reviews; hotel_id, t = month index 0-148, ta_dummy, after = TA x post, first_response = hotel post indicator, treated, interval, ash_interval). Blocks: run_xplatform_dd (dd-xplatform.tex, main Table: xtreg stars after ta_dummy first_response c.ta_dummy#c.t i.t, fe robust; col 2 drops Ashenfelter-dip window; col 3 adds cum_avg_stars_lag log_count_reviews_lag); run_ddd (ddd.tex); run_xplatform_dd_by_travtype; run_xplatform_dd_het (responses_posted interactions); run_fake_reviews_dd (affiliation, pre_treatment_reviews interactions); run_wplatform_month_stayed (xtset hotel_id_month_stayed_id; xtreg stars first_response t_review_stay t_review_stay_2 c.treated#c.t i.t); run_review_len_dd (log_nr and review_length by star level, same cross-platform spec); goprobit (ordered probit, .ster files not shipped); user-fe reciprocity regression without time FE.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Distinct first months with after==1 among responding hotels in responses.dta.
